g_roast: Nine years weaving a moto through Lima at rush hour, causas, and this party still moves worse than the Panamericana on a Friday.
My sisters organised my whole childhood like a military campaign. Give them a week with this lot and you'd all be in bed by nine.
g_fire_back: Chevere, nice, coming from the pata who tried to ride a boar and lasted two seconds.
Ya, ya, fair, you got me there. I'll tell my sisters, they'll be delighted.
g_pile_on: It was worse, causas, I saw everything from the back. They ran past the healer, then shouted for the healer.
And when I patched them up they asked if it would scar. Pata, it's a scar already, you're looking at it.
lines.g_peacemake: Oe, both of you, slow down a minute. Sit, breathe, drink some water. Then talk, one at a time, like people.
lines.g_take_side: I'm with {name} on this, sorry, pata. It's not about who I like, it's what I saw.
lines.g_left_out: You two keep going, it's fine. I'll walk the camp and check on everyone.
lines.g_include: Ven, causa, sit with us. Nobody stays outside the circle on my watch, that's the only rule I've got.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, causas. We split up, nobody keeps track of anybody, and whoever falls behind is on their own.
lines.g_plan_yes: Chevere, that works. Simple, everybody covered, nobody left at the back.
lines.g_plan_no: No, pata, that plan leaves somebody behind, and I don't do that, not ever. Find another way and I'm in.
lines.g_hype: Ya, causas, stay close and stay behind me. I take the hits, you keep moving, and we all walk out of there.
lines.g_toast: I'm bad at speeches, so a short one. To my people, who walk toward the trouble with me. Salud to every one of you.
lines.g_cheers: Salud, causas, and somebody tell me where the anticuchos are.
g_quiet_line: Lima's sky is grey nearly every day and it never rains, only the garua, this little mist. People here wouldn't believe me.
Sunday was ceviche at my mum's, everybody talking at once. You couldn't hear anything, and it was perfect.
lines.g_after_wipe: Nobody move yet, I'm coming round. Let me look at you, one by one. Good, your colour's coming back. We go again when you're ready.
lines.g_crew: For a long time it was me alone, causas, at the front with nobody beside me. Now it's you lot, and I sleep better.
lines.g_exasperated: I asked for one thing, causas. Don't drag me if I go down. And who did you drag, causas? Me, the one person who asked not to be dragged.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see who's struggling before they know it themselves, {name}. On a crew, nothing is more useful.
lines.g_love_kind: You walk beside the slow ones without saying anything, {name}. I do that too, and it's good to have company.
lines.g_love_funny: You get a laugh out of me while I'm covered in somebody else's blood, {name}. That's a skill, pata, believe me.
lines.g_love_brave: You go toward the trouble when everybody else is running away, {name}. That's my kind of person.
lines.g_love_steady: Your hands stay calm, {name}, whatever is going on. I'd put you on the back of my bike any day.
lines.g_love_clever: You work out where we're going before the rest of us have our boots on, {name}. Chevere, very chevere.
lines.g_love_honest: You say the real thing, {name}, straight, no decoration. I like knowing where I am with somebody.
lines.g_love_quiet: You can keep somebody company without a word, {name}. That's rare, and I notice it.
lines.g_love_fierce: You never let go of anybody, {name}, never. That's the only thing that really matters, causa.
lines.g_love_warm: Being around you is like Sunday at my mum's table, {name}. Loud and warm and nobody wants to leave.
g_loved: Oe, stop it, pata, I'll turn red and then you'll think I've got a fever.
Ya, thank you, really. Now let me check your arm, it's bleeding again.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You keep pressing on people's sore spots, {name}. I spend my days closing wounds, not opening them.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep asking if I'm hurt, {name}. I'm the one who checks, causa, let me do my job.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, somebody's bleeding. Make the joke after, and I'll laugh, I promise.
lines.g_hate_brave: You rush ahead and leave the rest of us behind, {name}. Brave is going in together.
lines.g_hate_steady: You freeze when the moment comes, {name}. In Lima traffic you'd last one block.
lines.g_hate_clever: You tell everybody what they did wrong after it's over, {name}. Tell them before, or help them during.
lines.g_hate_honest: Everything you think comes straight out, {name}. Some of it can wait until the bleeding's stopped.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never say when you're hurt, {name}, then you fall over. Tell me, that's what I'm for.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, {name}, even dinner. Relax, causa, the ceviche isn't attacking.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk while I'm working on somebody, {name}. I need quiet to count, pata, please.
lines.g_respect: You and I clash, {name}, I know. But you didn't leave anybody back there, and that's what counts with me.
lines.g_call_out: That was on you, {name}, and I'll say it gently. You went ahead alone, and somebody nearly paid for it.
lines.g_stung: Ya, fair, I hear you. I'll walk a bit.
lines.g_concede: You had it right, {name}, I had it wrong. No problem, I'd rather know.
lines.g_callback_save: You carried me out when I went down, {name}, even though I told everybody not to. I'm still annoyed, and still alive.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, everyone else on the floor, both of us bleeding. That's a crew of two, pata.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you said I'd gone too far ahead, I was cross until dinner. After dinner I looked behind me, and you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: The first weeks, {name}, I took you for somebody who'd save themselves first. I couldn't have been more wrong.
lines.g_changed: I used to stand at the front alone and expect nobody, causas. Lately I look round and somebody's beside me.
g_unguarded: Just us, pata, so I'll say it. I keep a list of the hubs I haven't checked. It gets shorter, and that frightens me.
Between you and me. If somebody tells me to leave someone behind, I stop working. Something in me just switches off.
lines.g_clipped: Ya, your call. I'll be at the back.
lines.g_noticed_open: Oe, look at you, telling it all the way through. Keep going, causa, I've got time.
arg_ask: {player}, pata, help us out here. Both sides are out, calm, and we're going round like a combi with no route.
Oe, {player}, you decide this one. Listen to both of us and choose, and I'll live with it.
lines.arg_backed_me: Gracias, {player}, chevere. I'll try not to smile too much.
lines.arg_backed_them: Ya, your call, I'll ride with it. It's the wrong road, but ya.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Keeping clear of it, eh. I don't blame you, pata.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Every quarrel ends on their side, {player}. Calm, yes, but I notice.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody's choosing, so I'll choose, ya. My way, and we move.
lines.arg_reject: No, {player}, not that one, sorry. Not if it means somebody gets left.
lines.arg_grumble: Ya, I'll drop it. Mostly, causa, mostly.
lines.arg_settled: Each of you gets half, chevere. Shake on it and let's eat.
lines.seen_listens: You let people get the whole thing out, {player}, even when it takes a while. I see that, and it matters.
lines.seen_truth: You give people the news straight, {player}, even the bad news. I'd want it that way myself.
lines.seen_jokes: On the ugly days you crack everybody up, {player}. Every ambulance base needs one of those.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the fights, {player}. Smart, pata, smarter than most.
lines.seen_biased: The same one gets the good stuff every trip, {player}. Others see it too, causa.
lines.seen_harsh: You can be tough with people, {player}. My skin's thick, but some of these causas are hurting already.
lines.seed_right: That advice from the terrible run, {player}, I tried it. It worked, and I wanted you to know.
lines.seed_remember: What you said that bad night is still riding around in my head, {player}. Nothing decided, but they're there.
lines.seed_wrong: I did it your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just telling you, no hard feelings.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Oe, {player}, sit with me a second. That one got close, too close, and afterwards my hands wouldn't stay still.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us down, me first. Come, let's go back over it, slow, the way we'd do it after a bad call, and nobody gets blamed.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped before I could get to them, {player}. Standing in front is my job, and I wasn't in front enough.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everybody walking, colour good on all of them. Those are the best days, pata, the quiet ride back.
lines.talk_development: Can I ask you something, pata? Do I seem different? Last night somebody else took the front, and I actually slept.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've barked at {name} lately, {player}. Tired, I talk like I'm still on a call, all orders, and {name} has had the worst of it.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Oe, {player}, a question for you. Is {name} fond of me, or just the guy who patches them up?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I clash all the time, {player}. But if I go down, I want them standing over me.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s colour is off, {player}, and not the bleeding kind. Something's weighing on them.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Pata, a quiet word, and I'll keep it calm. Every trip the best loot rides home with {name}. If there's a reason, tell me.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: Straight with you, {player}. {name} and I don't work, and acting like we do makes it worse for everyone.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going in with nobody watching the way out, {player}. That's exactly how somebody gets forgotten, and I won't have it.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I had {name} wrong, {player}. They saw it right, I didn't, and I want that said out loud.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Calm question, {player}. On the big runs, you leave me behind. Is it my work, or something else?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit changed hands to {name}, pata, and nobody said. It was theirs if they wanted it, {player}, I'd just have liked a word.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, {player}, that helps, really. Let me make you something to eat.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: Ya, I'll mend, pata, I'm good at mending. Give it a night.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, pata, sorry. I'm going to walk it off.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you've seen it too. Chevere, then it's real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not. Ask me again in a month, causa.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, pata, that's not it. You've read the chart wrong.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Ya, fair, {name} and I will sit down, calm, just the two of us.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I don't know. People don't come with a pulse you can count.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, please, I never said it. Nothing to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Ya, that one's earned. Stings a bit, but it's earned.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Got it, {player}, ya. I'll sleep on it.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Ya, so that's how it is. Good to know, pata.
lines.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that for me tonight, causa. I'll be with the others.
lines.arc_cracks: I didn't add a hub to the list this week, {player}. I was too busy with all of you, and I didn't even notice until today.
lines.arc_turn: I've been searching like the search is the only thing I've got, {player}. Maybe it isn't, any more.
lines.arc_become: The looking won't stop, causas. But I'm not alone at the front now. I've got a crew, and that's already a home.
lines.arc_failed: Still checking every hub, still alone at the front, {player}. Stopping is beyond me, and so is letting anybody in.
lines.alt_turn: There are four hubs left on the list, {player}, only four. What do I do when it says zero?
lines.alt_become: The front is still mine, every fight. But I'm running out of places to look, pata, and I'm running out of me.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the slowest party in any traffic, causas, and I'd ride every shift with you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slow, hands out to whoever's next to you. That's how my crew works, nobody climbs out alone.
lines.g_toast_after: To my crew, who stood next to me at the front when I'd forgotten anybody could. Salud, causas, all of you.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, causas, for good. Two on a fast thing, and then some.
g_quiet_line_after: Slept right through with somebody else on watch. Trusting that is a new thing for me.
Made ceviche tonight for all of you, and everybody talked at once. Just like Sundays.
g_loved_after: Gracias, pata, really. And I believe you, which is new.
Oe, now I'm red, look at me. Thank you, causa.

history.open: One promise before we go anywhere, {player}. If I go down, don't drag me. Get everybody else out first. Nine years on a motorbike ambulance in Lima, and that's the one rule I keep.

options.reply: Lima's traffic kills more people than it should, pata. An ambulance can't get through, a bike can. Me, the bag, and a lot of shouting.
Ya, nobody does. I ask anyway. One day somebody's going to say yes, and I'll be very surprised.
Ha, chevere, now we understand each other. You'll be the one with the sore back, not me.

history.open: I keep a list, {player}. Every hub I haven't checked yet for people I knew. It used to be long. The second year was worse than the first, because by then I'd checked everywhere close.

options.reply: My mum, my sisters, and my old partner on the bike. I'll tell you about her one day. She'd hate me talking about her without swearing first.

options.text: How did you get through it?
options.reply: I worked, pata. That's the whole answer, in those words. You stand in front of people and the days go by.

history.open: My partner on the bike was Gladys Huaman, {player}. Ten years older than me, an old nurse with the filthiest mouth in Lima and the fastest hands I've ever seen. She trained me from nothing and swore at me every day for six years. I loved her like a sister.

options.reply: She'd say she sounds like a pain in the neck, and she'd be right. But yes, she was. Wonderful, and a pain in the neck.
I hope so, pata. I don't make anybody else carry it, but thank you for saying it like you believe it.

friend.open: The morning it happened, {player}, Gladys and I were racing to the same call. Only two streets apart, that close. Then I was in Ashenvale with the windlass on my jacket and she wasn't anywhere. I think about those two streets every day.

options.reply: No, I know. My head knows. The rest of me keeps riding those two streets, faster every time, and never getting there.

options.text: She was looking for you too.
options.reply: Maybe she was, pata. That's the thought I hold on to when the list gets short, and you just gave it back to me.

sworn.open: I always wanted a crew of two again, {player}. Two people on a fast thing, going toward what everyone else runs from. I think I've found the other one, and it's you.

options.reply: Chevere, causa, that's settled. Then hold on tight, and don't you dare drag me.
Ha, never, pata, nobody drives but me. You can hold the bag, it's an honour.

reconciled.open: {name} and I had it out, calm, over a plate of food, no shouting. All good now, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Gracias, pata, feels better already. Lighter, you know?
Ha, of course I did, it was very good. Mine too, finally.
